content.text: Redeem your My Nintendo Platinum Points for fun rewardsStoreGamesTomodachi Life™: Living the DreamSlide 1 of 9Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 7:50Remaining Time 7:50Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 21:57Remaining Time 21:57Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 7:50Remaining Time 7:50Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 21:57Remaining Time 21:57Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 7:50Remaining Time 7:50Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 21:57Remaining Time 21:57Game Voucher eligibleBecome the caretaker of an island full of silliness, drama, love, and other surprises!Absurd situations await as you populate your island with Mii™ characters based on yourself, family, friends, or original creations. Get to know them, design a world for them to explore, and watch them come to life in the Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream game for the Nintendo Switch™ system.Create Mii characters based on family, friends, or your own original ideasYour experience in the game depends on the characters you create to live on your island. There are a few ways to build and collect Mii characters.Active gallery item: 1 of 2.Breaking News!MiiNews is your source for everyday happenings on your island. You’ll get reports once per day from the Mii News station, plus updates for earth-shattering events.Active gallery item: 1 of 2.LATEST NEWSReport: Hugh Morris can never keep his hoodie strings evenDr. Winters spotted waddling around townCan Mocha have a word?Update: Angie feels a little betterHugh Morris is totally in love with the view from the Ferris wheelWait...is Angie falling for Hugh Morris?Patrick remains aloofGet to know MiiLearn about your characters’ likes and dislikes, their relationships, and more as you participate in the melodrama that is their lives.Take care of MiiGive your Mii characters food, clothes, treasures, and more to make their lives a little nicer. Sometimes they’ll love what they get! Other times…not so much. But don't worry, they’ll always tell you what they do and do not like.Level Mii upA Mii will level up when their happiness gauge maxes out. Want to make them even happier? Reward them with gifts like quirks, expressions, and more.Befriend MiiFriendships between Mii characters can go in all sorts of directions. Characters might end up becoming best friends, living together, or having fights and holding grudges. Over time, their relationship may grow and blossom into something else.Pick Mii upIf one of your Mii characters is sitting inside moping, you can simply pick them up and place them near another character so they can chat and hang out.Pop in on MiiOnce your island is hopping, you can pop in on your creations as they chill at home. Decorate their homes and give them the opportunity to move in together and create their own community.Customize their world and shape the landscapeMake your island a unique and fun place for your Mii characters to live! Design your island and place homes, stores, restaurants, and more to supply events and entertainment for your community.Explore your island facilitiesHere are a few locations you’ll unlock as you progress through the game.Wishing FountainCollect donations. Use in-game money to buy stuff. Give stuff to Miis to make them happy. Repeat daily.Active gallery item: 1 of 8.Create fun stuffCreate pets, food, clothing, and items like books and video games to suit each Mii on your island! Anything you make in the game can be exchanged with other players on their devices via local wireless*.Try the free demo and get an in-game Hamster CostumeExperience creating up to three Mii characters in the demo on Nintendo eShop! Your save data from the demo will carry over to the main game upon purchase, and if you complete the demo you’ll get a Hamster Costume that you can give to your Mii characters. The Hamster Costume is also available in the main game through regular play.
